profile.name: Byonoy Absorbance 96 酶标仪
profile.description: 这是一款面向96孔微孔板的吸光度酶标仪，用于在选定波长下测量各孔样品的吸光度信号。它适用于ELISA、比色分析以及其他基于微孔板的常规实验检测。
profile.description_en: This is a 96-well microplate absorbance reader used to measure sample absorbance in plate wells at selected wavelengths. It is suitable for ELISA, colorimetric assays, and other routine microplate-based laboratory measurements.
